scope: Local normal-Web credential change and Agent authorization revocation
tested_workflows: teacher and student profile password changes preserve the existing Web session but revoke old task and persistent grants
teacher administrator reset and inactive-account restore
student reset approval followed by password setup and a new Web session
wrong credentials and commit failure preserve/restore credentials and authorization
ordinary logout does not revoke persistent authorization

local_tests.commit_failure_proof: A real sqlite3.Connection subclass records exactly one attempted commit, raises at that boundary, and the same failed connection is checked after rollback for the original password and both active Agent grants. No proxy dialect mismatch can satisfy the test.

isolation.database: in-memory SQLite connection shared by the fixture HTTP dependencies and nested login/session aliases
isolation.initial_fixture_incident: The first setup test run missed imported common/session connection aliases and wrote two successive synthetic student:7 Web sessions to the local application database. Only the remaining session row whose UUID, identity, name and testclient address exactly matched this test run was removed (one row). Password/account SQL was always in memory. No production server was accessed.
isolation.limitation: The previous local student:7 session value, if one existed before that first test, cannot be reconstructed from this run; that local student may need to sign in again. This is not a claim that the initial test had no local side effects. The aliases and connector-deny guards are fixed for the passing run.

transaction_contract: Call prepare_credentials_change before account/password writes, then credentials_changed in the same transaction. Teacher management lock precedes ordered running-task locks, followed by the actor-specific issuance/revocation mutex. Delegation and persistent-grant issuance share that mutex and revalidate the source after acquiring it. C user confirmation completes its receipt before revoking the source session. No helper commits or performs DDL.
reset_approval_wait_regression: The test simulates a reset request becoming completed while credential preparation waits, then verifies the pending-status compare-and-swap returns 409 without resetting the student flag or revoking new authority. This test is a deterministic post-wait state regression, not a claim of a parallel PostgreSQL approval test.
